title: LIX2: update Timestamp to show UTC instead of Local
description:
TS33.128 table 7.3.3.2.1 Simple data type
Timestamp, GeneralizedTime
Unless otherwised specified, the timestamp shall be given qualified with
time zone information (i.e. as UTC or offset from UTC, not using the
local time format)

notes.body: enabled an automatic merge when the pipeline for c28e6205617f5c456fe5b357dfa35e0f41b2deda succeeds

commits_data.message:
LIX2: update Timestamp to show UTC instead of Local

TS33.128 table 7.3.3.2.1 Simple data type
Timestamp, GeneralizedTime
Unless otherwised specified, the timestamp shall be given qualified with
time zone information (i.e. as UTC or offset from UTC, not using the
local time format)
